audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], spikes[0] and early all say 'his Stone Skin passive tanks your Colossal Smash auto'.
audit.why: Stone Skin is stacking ARMOR and health regeneration. Colossal Smash's bonus is magic damage in an area, and it scales with 60% of Galio's bonus magic resist on top of AD and AP — an AP Galio's damage is overwhelmingly magic, and armour does not touch it. Presenting his passive as the reason your empowered auto does nothing tells the player to stop using the one melee tool that actually works through Wukong's defensive stat.
audit.corrected: Stone Skin stacks armour, and Colossal Smash's bonus is magic damage — his passive barely touches it. What Stone Skin does blunt is the physical part of the auto itself.
sources: champ-data/_kits/monkeyking.json (P Stone Skin: 'gains stacking armor and max health regeneration')
champ-data/_kits/galio.json (P Colossal Smash: 'next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area')
wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Colossal Smash: 15-115 + 100% AD + 40% AP + 60% bonus magic resistance)

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire plan is 'commit only when Nimbus Strike AND the clone are both spent' — wants.you[0], mid, whys[2], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] — and neither cooldown is ever given.
audit.why: Warrior Trickster is 22/21/20/19/18 and Nimbus Strike is 10/9.25/8.5/7.75/7. That is the whole matchup in two numbers: the clone is the long one, so a spent Warrior Trickster buys you roughly 22 seconds at rank 1, while his Nimbus Strike is back in ten. Waiting for both is really waiting for the clone. Crushing Blow is 8s and Cyclone is 130/110/90.
audit.corrected: Warrior Trickster 22s at rank 1 — that is your window. Nimbus Strike 10s, Crushing Blow 8s, Cyclone 130s. Play the clone's clock, not the dash's.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0] says 'E-punch into his Nimbus Strike (it catches you mid-dash)', phases[2].why says the charge is 'interruptible and root-able mid-flight', and the focus of the whole full layer is Nimbus Strike.
audit.why: Nimbus Strike is a dash to a target with no crowd control on it — it cannot catch anyone. Wukong's only hard CC is Cyclone's knockup, and his only answer to a committed Galio is Warrior Trickster: invisibility, a dash and a clone your taunt will happily lock onto. The full layer is tracking the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Nimbus Strike has no CC and cannot catch you. The button that beats your combo is Warrior Trickster — the clone eats the taunt and he leaves invisible — and the only hard CC he owns is Cyclone's knockup.
sources: champ-data/_kits/monkeyking.json (E Nimbus Strike flags: dash only; W Warrior Trickster: 'becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone'; R Cyclone: 'Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up')
wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Justice Punch cannot be interrupted mid-travel)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says Cyclone's knockup cancels Galio's channels.
audit.why: Shield of Durand only taunts on release, and Hero's Entrance is CC-immune only after 1.25 seconds of its 2.75-second channel. Cyclone knocks up everything it touches on a 130-second cooldown, so it both cancels a charging W and can interrupt an ultimate that started too close to him. That is the single most punishing thing he can do to a Galio and it is not on the page.
audit.corrected: Cyclone knocks up, so it cancels a charging Shield of Durand outright and can interrupt Hero's Entrance inside its first 1.25 seconds — never start either within his 315 radius.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (W taunt applied on recast; Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s with CC immunity after 1.25s)

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow is never identified as an auto-attack reset, and its bonus attack range is never mentioned.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags 'autoreset-burst-tell: Wukong's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Crushing Blow (Q))', and the kit confirms the autoReset flag plus a range that grows 250 to 350 with rank. So his opener is an auto and an instant armour-shredding second hit from further away than his normal reach — the wind-up, not the cast, is the moment to start the W.
audit.corrected: Crushing Blow resets his auto and extends his reach to 250-350, so the opener is two hits in one beat from outside normal melee range.
sources: champ-data/_kits/monkeyking.json (Q Crushing Blow: 'next attack gains attack range', range 250/275/300/325/350, flags autoReset)

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Skill, Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Skill, Wukong, Wukong while the prose gives Level 1 to Wukong outright ('you flat-out lose the opening'), calls Level 3 'genuinely even', gives Levels 4-5 to Wukong ('the lane-control band tilts to him') and Level 6 to Galio ('Hero's Entrance is your spike').
audit.why: Four of seven rows disagree with the sentence printed beside them, including Level 1 and Level 6 — the two rows a player actually plans around.
audit.corrected: Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Wukong, Galio, Wukong, Wukong, which also matches 43.33%.
sources: scratchpad packet galio.json entry wukong (43.33%, 60 games)

audit.whatIsWrong: The range gap is never stated.
audit.why: Winds of War is 825, Nimbus Strike is 650 and Crushing Blow reaches at most 350. early says 'last-hit at max Winds of War range' without the number, so the player has no idea how much room he actually owns.
audit.corrected: Winds of War is 825 against a 650 Nimbus Strike — outside 650 he has to spend the dash to reach you at all.

audit.why: The packet flags "Crushing Blow's" and "Shield of Durand's" as probable wrong ability names. Both are false positives from the near-miss matcher. The entry's claim that the stance is 'amped against magic' and barely blunts his physical burst is also correct — 25/30/35/40/45% versus magic against 12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5% versus physical.
43.33% over 60 games. EVEN at 6/10 is a touch generous but within reason for a lane Galio survives and out-maps; the chart, not the label, was the thing pointing the wrong way.

edits.before: This is the band where you stop bleeding, but you don't take over. Your level 6 is the actual lifeline: Hero's Entrance won't win you this lane, but it lets you flag a sidelane and make a 2v1 happen elsewhere, which is your whole win condition in a lane you're losing. Shove and look for that rotation rather than forcing a fair fight you lose.
